name: Table Rollup
changes: In the free version, a view that sets Summary row, Group by column or Filter column shows a line in the bar that names these Pro options and says that the view does not use them. Click the line to see how to get Pro.
tip: Click a column header twice to sort the rows in the other direction.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Table Rollup is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
